title: chlorophytum cooperi
intro: Chlorophytum cooperi, commonly known as Spider Plant, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Asparagaceae. This plant is widely valued for its air-purifying properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Chlorophytum cooperi include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory function, and alleviate anxiety and stress.
